data.additional_information:
The Institute is looking for candidates that share the same motivation for innovation and excellence in teaching and learning process delivery. We are offering to the right candidate an excellent compensation package along with the tools and the environment to foster intellect and new ideas. Join us and we will innovate and explore the world of education (Teaching & Learning) together. Please visit us at www.kiet.edu for more details.

I. Designation: Assistant Professor

II. Job Purpose:
To oversee the design and development of the curriculum, and deliver a range of programmes of teaching to students, in order to ensure teaching within the quality assurance framework of the College. To lead the development and implementation of the College’s research strategy and co-ordinate research activity within the specific subject area.

III. Work Experience (Knowledge, Skills and Behavior)

 Ability or definite promise in teaching, research, extension, and/or another scholarly or creative activity.  Potential for directing teaching, research, graduate study, or extension activities.  Ability and willingness to participate in university affairs.  An M.Tech degree with relevant professional experience

KNOWLEDGE

Teaching & Learning
 To design and develop overall curricula, and deliver a range of lectures
 Teaching students as per syllabus & ordinance of the university.
 Organizing & conducting lectures/tutorials/practical. Timely finishing the syllabus
 Maintenance of discipline & order during classes and also till the time the next teacher comes for taking the class. Preparation of lesson plans, tutorial sheet
 Maintenance of discipline & order during classes and also till the time the next teacher comes for taking the class. Evaluation of students and monitoring their conduct, discipline & behavior.
 Maintenance of proper documentation. Proper documentation/record of students
 To transfer knowledge including practical skills, methods and techniques

Research & Development
 Involvement of faculty in R&D projects. Current research project of faculty.
 To challenge thinking, foster debate and develop the ability of students to engage in critical discourse and rational thinking. Involvement of faculty in guiding the students for their research projects.
 To write or contribute to publications or disseminate research finding/Writing research paper & books.
 Attending/organizing faculty development programme in the department/institute
